name: – After § 4 – Am 12
title: Resolution on the devastating floods in central and eastern Europe, the loss of lives and the EU’s preparedness to act on such disasters exacerbated by climate change
part_text: 4a. Reminds NGOs and civil society groups that having influence in decision-making, whether formal or informal, comes with significant responsibility; if their lobbying efforts or opposition to critical adaptation infrastructure projects, such as dam construction, lead to widespread destruction of property during floods, they should be held accountable; these groups should face both financial and legal consequences for obstructing measures that could have prevented such devastation;
